description: This file defines a Python module for interacting with the LiveAvatar Streaming API, including data models, API client class, and methods for session management.

classes.name: AvatarPersona
classes.description: Defines avatar persona settings including voice, context, and language.

classes.name: CustomSDKLiveKitConfig
classes.description: Configuration for connecting to a custom LiveKit server.

classes.name: LiveAvatarNewSessionRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new LiveAvatar session token.

classes.name: SessionTokenData
classes.description: Holds session ID and token for authentication.

classes.name: SessionTokenResponse
classes.description: Response containing session token data and status.

classes.name: LiveAvatarSessionData
classes.description: Contains details about an active LiveAvatar session, including URLs and tokens.

classes.name: LiveAvatarSessionResponse
classes.description: Response for starting a LiveAvatar session, including session data.

classes.name: LiveAvatarApi
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the LiveAvatar API, including session management methods.

methods.name: create_session_token
methods.description: Creates a session token for LiveAvatar.

methods.name: start_session
methods.description: Starts a new LiveAvatar session using a session token.

methods.name: new_session
methods.description: Creates and starts a new LiveAvatar session, returning a standardized response.

methods.name: close_session
methods.description: Closes an active session using stored session token.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Internal method to make HTTP requests to the API.
